note: Lanes group related tasks so one worker (and its submaster, if the task is big) owns a stream of work. Tasks in a lane run in order. Shared-file owners say which lane may edit a shared file first; the others rebase after it merges.

lanes.name: Books and posting
lanes.about: Posting engine, party ledger, balances and reports. Z2 parts of C1 stay out.

lanes.name: Jobs, events and integration
lanes.about: Outbox, events, job runner, invite delivery, then the integration surface. Z4 secrets stay out.

lanes.name: Masters and Packs
lanes.about: Trees, effective dating, UoM; then Pack packaging (no licence text, Z5). C8 after C7 (Z3).

lanes.name: Desk, first run and access
lanes.about: Install and first-run flow, B7 leftovers, steering sync, then public pages (ADR).

lanes.name: Quality and follow-ups
lanes.about: The follow-ups list in tasks.md (one small fix per commit), D1 and D2 Proposed drafts, Bruno coverage.

sharedFiles.internal/server/sysmigrations.go: master reserves the next migration number per task in migrations.md before a worker writes it
sharedFiles.internal/server/gate.go: append-only entries; rebase conflicts are resolved by master at merge
sharedFiles.web/src/App.vue: one lane at a time; ask master
sharedFiles.proto/athena/v1/*.proto: one proto file per lane; a new service gets its own file
